pages.text: Entries have three levels:$(li)$(l)Seen$(): it is within 24 blocks and in view$(li)$(l)Fought$(): you (or your units or powers) hurt it, or it hurt you$(li)$(l)Defeated$(): the kill is credited to you; for trial bosses every participant counts; summoning counts as taming$(br2)Entries you haven't seen are locked. The record is kept on your character, so losing the book doesn't reset it.

$(l)Things people say$():$(li)Centaurs camp in meadows, plains, flower forests and windswept forests$(li)Noisy flocks nest in the dead trees of swamps$(li)You hear shrill laughter from the cliffs of windswept hills, windswept forests and stony shores$(li)Something big walks sideways along marshes and rocky shores

$(li)A spirit guards old oaks in flower forests and meadows$(li)In collapsed temples, the statues turn to watch you$(li)A bull-headed monster lives deep in the Labyrinth of Knossos$(li)Trade favor for the winged horse's summon token at a Patron Statue
